他低下头吻了她。

en: to force or persuade somebody to do what you want or to accept your opinions
ex: He manipulates people and tries to bend them to his will (= make them do what he wants).
他能左右民众，让大家跟随他的意志。

zh: （一段时间）狂饮作乐，大量吸毒
en: a period of drinking a lot of alcohol or taking a lot of drugs
ex: to go on a bender
纵酒作乐

en: that can be bent easily
ex: a bendy road
迂回的道路

zh: 铰接式公共汽车；多节巴士
en: a long bus that bends in the middle so that it can turn corners more easily
ex: The bendy bus is an attempt to improve the city’s public transport.
弯曲公交车是试图改善城市的公共交通。

zh: 在（或往）…下面；在（或往）…下方
en: in or to a lower position than somebody/something; under somebody/something
ex: They found the body buried beneath a pile of leaves.
他们发现尸体被埋在一堆树叶下面。

en: a first name for boys

zh: (1741-1801) an American general who betrayed his country in the American Revolution. Although at first he fought bravely and won battles for the Americans, he tried in 1780 to give the fort (= strong military building for defence) at West Point, which he commanded, to the British. He failed and escaped to London. His name is still used by Americans to mean somebody who betrays their country.
